priority: This file and the final master plan override differing illustrative numeric targets in topic appendices.
protected_budget_excess_verdict: BLOCKED_PROTECTED_DEBT, never PASS or unauthorized deletion
physical_allocation_limit_note: Admission budgets need per-operation worst-case growth margins; they are not a file-system guarantee that an already-in-flight write cannot allocate an extra page.
memory_configuration_lock: B00 lock device/model/workload calibration before B12 trial; do not tune after observing failure
memory_native_budget_basis: sum of measured owner reservations; never infer native hard cap from Java maxMemory
memory_live_heap_evidence: post-observed-major-GC live set or controlled isolated heap inspection; no per-issue forced GC
timing_definition: validated_response_to_draw_commit starts at complete response body received, before parse/validation, for responses ultimately validated; request start/first byte/received/validated/commit are all retained; invalid responses and missing periods retain terminal failure counts
